items.title: Citi upgrades Ford to Buy on improving F-Series momentum, lifts PT to $20
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi upgraded Ford Motor to Buy from Neutral and raised its price target to $20 from $19, saying improving F-Series pickup production, easing warranty costs and better aluminum supply are driving a positive shift in the automaker's earnings outlook.
